summary: Accepted the exact P1 contract as a source-grounded engineering reuse critique, not a scientific result. Independent read-only checks found no contradiction in the minimum sample guard, fixed-origin sample phases, Dev72 window independence, aggregate visibility/null meaning, or mandatory source/crop disagreement retention. The immutable 23-entry d31b and 14-entry 5b59 closures match. No CV, source image, course protocol, implementation, or scientific acceptance was involved.

checks.method: SHA256 of exact manifest bytes and every named closure entry; source reads only

checks.falsificationAttempt: Could a perfect unmasked nT=7 profile fit, or could nT=8 itself guarantee a fit?
checks.finding: No. ok[j] <= nT, need=max(8,0.2*nT), and nGood/M must be at least0.6. nT<8 guarantees no good offset and null. nT>=8 alone is not sufficient: masking can fail the guard, and passing the guard still requires rising/falling peaks within requested width and lateral search. P1 states both limits and does not invent a new threshold.

checks.falsificationAttempt: Could adjacent endpoint labels or reanchored local t values guarantee that short profiles partition the same original-world samples as the long profile?
checks.finding: No. arange forms n=ceil((t1-t0)/step) and t=t0+k*step; profileAt evaluates O + t*u + offset*n in floating-point. Short t0 phases, upper bounds, reanchored origins and integer crop translation can change generated positions or arithmetic even for nominally equivalent geometry. P1 requires fixed O/heading for primary contrast, exact generated lattices/coverage/phase sidecars and separately declared reanchoring. This is adequate as a contract, not evidence that any not-yet-seen protocol satisfies it.
checks.executionNote: No sample generator or CV function was executed. Source inspection only. An admitted actual protocol must bind the generated original-frame coordinates/phases, not merely interval lengths or visual adjacency.

checks.falsificationAttempt: Do changed t0/t1 at identical pose make independent Dev72 longitudinal observations?
checks.finding: No. Composition passes only xPx/yPx/headingRad/corridorWidthPx, boxes and raster into the sensor. Its tangent band is the unchanged local pose sample. P1 explicitly calls repeated same-pose sensor rows duplicates and requires reanchoring as a declared ablation. No hidden per-window sensor corroboration is claimed.

checks.source: pathSpace.mjs#profileAt and #edgePairOf; composition/recipe.mjs midpoint and receipt construction
checks.falsificationAttempt: Can equal aggregate visible counts prove simultaneous bilateral support, or can literal null be treated as zero displacement or physical edge absence?
checks.finding: No. Each normal offset accumulates its own unmasked t subset and receipt contains counts, not per-t identities. edgePairOf has several null routes and no reason enum; source can interpolate between good offsets before fitting. A pair on averaged/interpolated profiles does not establish per-t bilateral edges. P1 retains all counts/raw fits/nulls/UNKNOWN and forbids those interpretations. Its observationalCounterexample is a record of contrast, not a physical absence finding.

checks.source: adapter.mjs#compareControls/#runSourcePixelRoi; immutable adapter tests for rotated fit selection and preserved source/crop controls; Dev72 #grayAt
checks.falsificationAttempt: Could copied RGBA rows and integer translation authorize replacing the source receipt with crop output, or relax tolerance after disagreement?
checks.finding: No. Adapter runs crop then original-source recipes, preserves both receipts, compares learner/profiles/counts/candidates with fixed1e-9 tolerance and returns equivalence UNKNOWN on retained discrepancies. Dev72 nearest Math.round and JS bilinear/smoothing/strict peak selection have different arithmetic seams. P1 mandates both branches and every discrepancy, explicitly denying generic crop invariance and success-row substitution.

checks.falsificationAttempt: Could parent/control metadata be inserted into station objects, training be silently dropped, or ROI refusal be converted into an executed null grid?
checks.finding: No. Accepted adapter station/top-level keys are allowlisted and complete training support is mandatory. P1 places semantic grouping in sidecars by exact IDs, preserves zero-call whole-request UNKNOWN/NOT_EXECUTED and distinguishes integrity failures from photometric observations.

Existing stations/window fields express the contrast. P1 does not require a new runner, CV operation, threshold, calibration, tracker or production wiring. Declared ablations and checklist are future protocol requirements, not performed experiments. Same-edge continuity, semantic identity and calibrated width remain UNKNOWN.

nonblockingReviewNotes: The word missing in the initial question must continue to mean an unavailable local fitted pair, not absent physical edges; the latentClaim and explicit exclusions already resolve this.

No actual course protocol or localized-gap falsifier has been inspected or executed. Contract acceptance does not establish sample-phase matching, adequacy, scientific discriminability, or a new helper gap for such a protocol.

No new helper is justified by this contract review alone. A narrow receipt-only helper remains gated on root demonstrating the localized bookkeeping failure and issuing its separate implementation packet.
scope: Exact fixed producer contract only; accepted is technical engineering review, not new scientific acceptance or execution authority.
